kitDescription: Little Mermaid is a Burst-I Wind supporter whose kit is a team rotation engine: every time a Full Burst ends she cuts 7.48 seconds off all allies' burst cooldowns, and every 400 rounds the whole team expends she instantly fills 37% of the burst gauge. On Full Burst entry she grants the team 4% Attack Damage for 10 seconds, and during each Full Burst she deals 63.36% of her ATK to enemies four times per second; separately, every 500 team rounds fired triggers a ten-hit 85% Bubble Barrage. She permanently keeps a Bubble debuff on the boss raising all damage it takes by 5.05%, and after she lands 50 normal attacks the bubble pops into an Explosive Bubble that re-applies the same 5.05% debuff and stuns the boss for 3 seconds. Her own burst gives all allies 10.13% Attack Damage for 10 seconds, reloads 33.26% of everyone's magazine, and grants herself an ATK buff equal to 17.28% of her own ATK for 10 seconds.

gotchas.summary: Sequential flavor dropped: modeled as a sustained-flavored DoT (253.44%/s); the kit's 'attacks sequentially 4 times' marks the hits sequential-flavored, so a teammate's Sequential Damage ▲ buff would not gate onto them
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Deals 63.36% of final ATK as damage. Attacks sequentially 4 times.' SSOT: Sustained/Sequential Damage ▲ buffs gate on hit flavor (damage-calculation.md §1e); dots are sustained-flavored function damage (§2c). Driver: dot 253.44 noRange (magnitude/cadence video-verified, control/lm.MP4 2026-07-15). Blind S2b/S5/S6: all three carry flavor 'sequential'. Unobservable at scope lock — no sequentialDamagePct source in any fixture.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Re-express as interval{sec:1} + fbGate:'inFb' with 4× flatDamage 63.36 flavor:'sequential' (fbGate and flavor are schema-supported; this preserves the measured 10-ticks-per-window cadence and the measured magnitude), or add flavor:'sequential' to the dot effect if the schema permits and document the boundary-tick convention. Magnitudes unchanged — the measurement stands.

verdictRationale: Eight of ten kit lines converged across the driver and both blind families — all of skill1, both burst blocks, and the Bubble passive are line-for-line identical, and the driver's 22-test matrix is green-vs-shipped / red-vs-nearest-wrong on every one (S2d verified). The two real divergences classify cleanly. First, Explosive Bubble: the S5/S6 blinds stacked a second additive 5.05% to reach 10.1% — but the S2b pre-op spec had pre-registered exactly that stacking as the nearest-WRONG model, and the driver's kit-literal relocation reading (Removes Bubble + the same 5.05% re-applied, net single stack, gate closed) is what S2b required; the driver also holds the 10.1% coexistence branch as an explicit ⚑ MEASUREMENT-GATED flag with a concrete recipe, which is the correct non-fudge handling — the blind read here is the recon error, not the driver. Second, the sequential-granularity dialect on the two damage riders: the driver's folded encodings (253.44%/s DoT, flatDamage 850) are independently video-verified (measured FB-boosted sub-hit 337,736 to 2.2%; all four sub-hits land on the single boss) and user-confirmed (850 per hit, core:false), so the substance is right and the measurement bar is met — the only genuine finds are two low-severity FIDELITY gotchas: the undocumented dropped 'sequential' flavor tag on both riders, unobservable at scope lock and fixable with a schema-supported one-word tag. The remaining S5 reds are blind-side plumbing artifacts (two no-op delta patches targeting the blind's own expected encoding, one hard-coded 98,367 static-ATK constant vs the fixture's 100,317). Nothing blocks GO; fix the two flavor tags forward and keep F1 gated. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the 5.05%-vs-10.1% Explosive-Bubble coexistence question is a shared prose prior across every agent — only the prescribed in-game debuff-icon/popup read ~5s into a fight settles it, and the separate ~22% normals over-credit is a board-level SMG range-dependent-core residual, not an LM kit encoding issue.
